attributes.name: heading underline accent
attributes.definition: Whether section headings are paired with a short decorative accent bar or underline beneath the text.

values.definition: A short colored bar or underline sits beneath the heading text.
A rule spanning the full width accompanies the heading.
No underline or rule decoration under headings.

attributes.name: section heading text style
attributes.definition: Typographic treatment of section headings, such as case and size.

values.definition: Ordinary-case heading with no distinctive treatment noted.

attributes.name: heading supporting text
attributes.definition: Additional text or links accompanying the section heading.

values.definition: A short descriptive line follows the heading.
A right-aligned link such as 'View all' sits on the heading row.
